lines.en: Sssss, closing in on the enemy!

lines.zh: 阳光下，我的影子最可怕。
lines.en: In the sunlight, my shadow is the scariest.
Under the sun, I am the strongest.

lines.zh: 阴影中，我比阳光更可怕。
lines.en: In the shadows, I'm more terrifying than the sun.

lines.zh: 无惨的意志，我永恒的魂。

lines.en: You dare not look me in the eye.
I am Urasai, the Demon King.

lines.zh: 他走过的地方，尘土都在抖。
身形一晃，已在你三格外。
lines.en: A flicker, and he is three blocks closer.

lines.zh: 我站在暗处，等太阳落下去。
lines.en: I stand in the dark, waiting for the sun to set.

lines.zh: 你背后的墙，我知道每一块砖。
lines.en: I know every brick in the wall behind you.

lines.zh: 第二形态的指尖，已经裂成鞭。
lines.en: In this form my fingertips have split into whips.

lines.zh: 鬼王的第二形态，正看着你。
lines.en: The demon king's second form has its eyes on you.
Such pain is beneath the Demon King.
Cold blood oozes from the wound.
Come closer, I'll feast on you.

lines.zh: 你流血的伤口，比说话更响。
lines.en: Your bleeding wound speaks louder than your words.

lines.zh: 第二形态，血鬼术还没用完。
lines.en: Second form, and my Blood Demon Art is not spent.

lines.zh: 我的力量在你身上觉醒。
我撞上来时，骨头会先响。
lines.en: When I slam into you, the bone cracks first.
Collide with me and regret it!

lines.zh: 你的刀抵着我，推不动半分。
lines.en: Your blade is against me and cannot push me an inch.

lines.zh: 我这一身血肉，会自己合上。
lines.en: My flesh knits itself back together.
You cannot dodge, I'll hit you.
That bump should show you the gap.

lines.zh: 我的力量比你想象的更强。
lines.en: My strength is greater than you imagined.
Come closer, I'll share my life with you.

lines.zh: 这一形态的血管都在颤。
lines.en: Every vein in this form is trembling.
My second form has only begun.

lines.zh: 我们的力量可以更强大。
lines.en: Our power can be greater together.
The taste of prey is delightful.

lines.zh: 第二形态，九百九十九点血。
lines.en: Second form, nine hundred ninety-nine health.

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的呼吸，隔墙也听得见。
lines.en: I can hear a slayer's breathing through walls.

lines.zh: 我数着你的呼吸，再等三拍。
lines.en: I count your breaths and wait three more beats.
In sunlight, you still can't escape.
The fear of prey is beautiful.

lines.zh: 鬼杀队的队服，太显眼了。
lines.en: A Demon Slayer uniform stands out too much.
He lifts a hand, blood dripping from a fingertip.

lines.zh: 你的名字，他已经知道了。

lines.en: The night wind pauses. He moves.
My Blood Demon Art, cannot be resisted.
Hunting until the last drop of blood.
My era, the end of Demon Slayers.

lines.zh: 血肉在他背后绽开成鞭。
lines.en: Flesh blooms from his back into whips.
He lifts his chin and looks down at you.
The air is thick with the smell of blood.
He neither dodges nor flinches as you swing.

lines.zh: 血鬼术沿着地面爬过来。
lines.en: His Blood Demon Art crawls along the ground.

lines.zh: 他在等你的下一次呼吸。
lines.en: He waits for your next breath.
He does not even glance at your blade.

lines.zh: 九条命的人都挡不住他。
lines.en: Nine lives would not be enough against him.

lines.zh: 他往阴影里退，避开天光。
lines.en: He slips into shadow, away from the daylight.

lines.zh: 指甲划开你的胸口，血溅到我脸上。
lines.en: My nails open your chest and blood spatters my face.

lines.zh: 血鞭抽在你的刀上，震得手麻。
lines.en: A blood whip cracks your blade and numbs your hands.

lines.zh: 他一掌推出，你飞出很远。
lines.en: He thrusts a palm and you fly far.

lines.zh: 指尖刺入肩头，血被抽走。
lines.en: Fingers pierce your shoulder; blood is drawn out.

lines.zh: 他的手臂伸长了，缠住你的腿。
lines.en: His arm stretches and coils around your leg.

lines.zh: 你砍中他，他连眉头都没动。
lines.en: You hit him. He does not even frown.

lines.zh: 他抓着你的领口提了起来。
lines.en: He lifts you by the collar.

lines.zh: 血雾散开，你什么也看不见。
lines.en: Blood mist bursts; you see nothing.
He hurls you into the rock wall.

lines.zh: 第一阶段结束了，他变了。
lines.en: The first phase ends. He changes.

lines.zh: 无惨撕开自己的皮肉，重新成形。
lines.en: Muzan tears his own flesh and reforms.

lines.zh: 鬼王的第二形态，站起来了。
lines.en: The Demon King's second form rises.

lines.zh: 气浪撕开我半张脸，又长回来。
lines.en: The blast tears half my face away; it grows back.

lines.zh: 箭杆扎进肩头，我懒得拔。
lines.en: The arrow shaft is in my shoulder; I can't be bothered to pull it.
This body doesn't need to eat.
